product.name: TJUSIG bench
product.note: Parts only: screws and fittings aren’t shown, and sizes are approximate. Each step names the page of your paper manual to follow.

steps.title: Start with a panel and 2 rails
steps.instruction: Join a panel and 2 rails (A, B, C), as the animation shows. Page 4 of the IKEA manual shows this step.
checklist: A panel and 2 rails are joined

faq.answer: This guide doesn’t show fittings for the TJUSIG bench. Page 4 of the paper manual shows which ones to use and how many.
The blue parts: A (panel, about 48 cm), B (rail, about 100 cm), C (rail, about 100 cm). Watch where they go in the animation.
Sizes are approximate: this model has no real measurements, so it is shown about 50 cm tall.
In 3 assembly videos, people took about 16 seconds on this step. Take your time.
